_comment: ARMOURED kit: the corner boss, for the outer corners and spar tips a hull ends at. A truncated PYRAMID rather than a dome - four sides, hard edges, sloped so nothing catches a round square on. The taper is 4-sided and turned 45 degrees about Y so its square is axis-aligned with the plate rather than standing on a diagonal. The dark lip under it is the kit's one repeated idea: every armoured piece is a light body standing on a dark base, so a piece reads as bolted on rather than as a lump of the plate it sits on.
